metadata.question: Was the NVDI lower in northern Kenya than in southern Kenya during May-June 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) over Kenya for 2019-05-01 to 2019-06-30, split Kenya by the Equator into north/south. If empty or no valid pixels after masking, fallback to Landsat 8 L2 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2).
2. Masking strategy: For Sentinel-2, mask clouds/cirrus via QA60 bits 10/11. For Landsat 8 L2, mask QA_PIXEL bits for dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow, snow. Create a median NDVI composite and compute mean NDVI per region. Cloud percentage estimated as 1 - (valid_pixel_count / total_pixel_count).
3. Valid-zero vs Null/Error: If collections empty -> C1. If valid pixel count is 0 in either region -> C2. If mean NDVI is null/NaN or outside [-1,1] -> C3. Otherwise compare means: north < south -> A, else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2019-05-01';
    const end = '2019-06-30';
    const scale = 3000;

    const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0');
    const kenyaFeat = gaul.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Kenya')).first();
    const kenya = ee.Feature(kenyaFeat).geometry();
    const northHem = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, 0, 180, 90], null, false);
    const southHem = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, 0], null, false);
    const northKenya = kenya.intersection(northHem, 1);
    const southKenya = kenya.intersection(southHem, 1);

    // Helpers
    function maskS2sr(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
      const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function s2ToNdvi(img) {
      const m = maskS2sr(img);
      const ndvi = m.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('ndvi');
      return ndvi.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }
    function maskL8L2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))     // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))     // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))     // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));    // snow
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function l8ToNdvi(img) {
      const m = maskL8L2(img);
      const red = m.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const nir = m.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('ndvi');
      return ndvi.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }
    async function getStats(ndviImg, region) {
      const validDict = await ndviImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const valid = validDict ? (validDict.ndvi || 0) : 0;

      const totalDict = await ee.Image(1).rename('ndvi').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const total = totalDict ? (totalDict.ndvi || 0) : 0;

      const meanDict = await ndviImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const mean = meanDict ? meanDict.ndvi : null;

      const cloudPct = (total > 0) ? (100 * (1 - (valid / total))) : 100;
      return { valid, total, cloudPct, mean };
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let dataset = 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(kenya)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
    let colSize = await col.size().getInfo();

    let ndviComposite = null;
    let usedDataset = null;
    let imagesUsed = 0;

    if (colSize === 0) {
      console.log(`S2 images: 0`);
      // Fallback to Landsat 8
      dataset = 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(kenya);
      colSize = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (colSize === 0) {
        console.log(`L8 images: 0`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      } else {
        const ndviCol = col.map(l8ToNdvi);
        ndviComposite = ndviCol.median();
        usedDataset = 'Landsat8-L2';
        imagesUsed = colSize;
      }
    } else {
      const ndviCol = col.map(s2ToNdvi);
      ndviComposite = ndviCol.median();
      usedDataset = 'Sentinel-2 SR';
      imagesUsed = colSize;

      // Check for valid pixels; if none, try Landsat
      const northStatsTmp = await getStats(ndviComposite, northKenya);
      const southStatsTmp = await getStats(ndviComposite, southKenya);
      const hasValid = (northStatsTmp.valid > 0) && (southStatsTmp.valid > 0);
      if (!hasValid) {
        console.log(`S2 images: ${imagesUsed} -> insufficient valid pixels`);
        // Fallback to Landsat 8
        dataset = 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2';
        col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filterBounds(kenya);
        colSize = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (colSize === 0) {
          console.log(`L8 images: 0`);
          console.log('C2');
          return;
        } else {
          const ndviColL8 = col.map(l8ToNdvi);
          ndviComposite = ndviColL8.median();
          usedDataset = 'Landsat8-L2';
          imagesUsed = colSize;
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing and Stats
    console.log(`Dataset: ${usedDataset} (May–Jun 2019), Images: ${imagesUsed}`);

    const northStats = await getStats(ndviComposite, northKenya);
    const southStats = await getStats(ndviComposite, southKenya);

    // Case C2: No valid pixels after masking
    if (northStats.valid === 0 || southStats.valid === 0) {
      console.log(`North pixels: ${northStats.valid}/${northStats.total} (cloud%: ${northStats.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
      console.log(`South pixels: ${southStats.valid}/${southStats.total} (cloud%: ${southStats.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation Validation
    const nMean = northStats.mean;
    const sMean = southStats.mean;

    console.log(`North pixels: ${northStats.valid}/${northStats.total} (cloud%: ${northStats.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`South pixels: ${southStats.valid}/${southStats.total} (cloud%: ${southStats.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    if (nMean === null || sMean === null || !isFinite(nMean) || !isFinite(sMean)) {
      console.log('Mean NDVI North: null, Mean NDVI South: null');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (nMean < -1.2 || nMean > 1.2 || sMean < -1.2 || sMean > 1.2) {
      console.log(`Mean NDVI North: ${nMean.toFixed ? nMean.toFixed(3) : nMean}, Mean NDVI South: ${sMean.toFixed ? sMean.toFixed(3) : sMean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Mean NDVI North: ${nMean.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`Mean NDVI South: ${sMean.toFixed(3)}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    const answer = (nMean < sMean) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    // Likely D: dataset/band/method errors, auth, or memory issues.
    const msg = (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err);
    console.log(`Error: ${msg}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
